jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**New York, NY · Full-time · Hybrid (in office 3 days a week) · $150,000 - $275,000 + equity**

**We’re deploying advanced agents into the real world to solve some of the biggest pain points in healthcare, and bringing the JOY back to healthcare by fixing the financial chaos behind it.**

Every year, healthcare practices fail to collect an estimated $125 billion in earned revenue. The money disappears into fragmented financial data, manual workflows, and opaque payer systems that don’t talk to one another. Often, these costs are passed on to patients through higher bills or rising health costs, and for many practices the losses are fatal.

Joyful Health builds AI agents that take on insurers so providers get paid for the care they deliver. We didn’t start with a product. We spent ten months working as fractional CFOs for a dozen practices, doing the work alongside providers before we wrote the technology that automates it.

We just announced our $22M Series A, led by CRV, with world-class investors including the founders of MongoDB and KAYAK. Now we’re doubling our engineering team.

**This role is full-time. We’re looking for someone NYC-based who is open to coming into the office 3 days a week.**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that let us scale. Every new customer adds claims, people, and operational complexity to the business behind our agents. These systems will handle hundreds of thousands of claims and automate complex operational processes, so they need to work at scale. You’ll find the bottlenecks across the company and build reliable, auditable, self-healing systems around them.

You’ll partner with eng, ops, RCM and finance teams to find the work that eats the most hours, then design a system that replaces it. You’ll ship in small steps, measure the impact, and move to the next bottleneck.

As a software engineer, you’ll have an outsized impact on the company’s trajectory, working on a critical problem that’s central to our success. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work on something extremely challenging and make a huge difference. You should be comfortable (and excited!) about working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment where you'll be able to wear many hats and take on new challenges as they arise.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
------------------

Here are some examples of what you’ll build:

* **Automatic claim routing.** An allocation engine that assigns work dynamically as volume, priorities, and capacity change.
* **Claims forecasting engine.** Models that predict incoming volume and workload, so we plan ahead of demand.
* **Staffing rebalancing.** Systems that match specialist and BPO capacity to demand across accounts.
* **Customized invoicing systems.** Billing that adapts to each customer’s terms and reconciles automatically.
* **Quality and monitoring systems.** Checks that catch process failures before they reach a customer.
* **Access and credential automation.** Secure, auditable provisioning for the portals and systems our team works in.
* **Internal metrics.** Reporting that updates itself and ties back to source data.
* **Privacy and Security.** Because this work touches sensitive data, you’ll design for security and HIPAA compliance from the start.

**WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF…**
----------------------------------

* **You’re passionate about Joyful Health’s mission.** You want to solve real, pressing problems for providers and put them in control of their businesses. You naturally empathize with users and enjoy building with their needs in mind.
* **You have 4+ years of experience in backend engineering,** with a focus on building data pipelines, integrations, and the infrastructure that supports them.
* **You have strong technical execution.** You view coding as a craft, not just a task, and you care about building a product that works at scale, with the user at the forefront. You bring:

  + Proficiency in Python and database systems, with familiarity in performance and optimization for scale
  + Experience in distributed systems coordination and AI pipelines
  + Familiarity with big data technologies and comfort working with massive datasets
  + Experience with CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions
  + Experience building reliable, observable production systems
* **You have a radical sense of ownership.** You have the ability and desire to own technical roadmaps and refine ambiguous problems.
* **You have a low ego and a growth mindset,** and you’re excited to shape our engineering team and culture as an early team member, leading by example and growing your impact as the product and team scale.
* We care more about your drive, hustle, and passion than a college degree from a shiny institution or experience at name-brand companies.

**Bonus points**

* You have experience working with healthcare data or solving interoperability challenges.
* You’ve built internal platforms or developer tooling used by other engineers.
* You’ve been a founder or an early engineer at a startup.

**WORKING AT JOYFUL**
---------------------

**Meaningful impact.** You’ll work on one of the most hair-on-fire problems providers face, so they can focus on caring for patients.

**Autonomy and ownership.** As an early team member, you’ll shape the company from the ground up.

**Growth and learning.** You’ll get direct access to experienced founders and advisors, plus stipends for professional development courses and books.

**Competitive compensation and equity.** $150K - $275K base, plus strong equity in Joyful Health.

**Be your best self.** Comprehensive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO (with a minimum of 10 days off a year), flexibility, and regular team off-sites and events.

Please apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. Nobody checks every box every time, and we’d love to talk with you abo

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Web)
jobs.description:
**About Grubhub**

At Grubhub, we believe food is more than just a meal: It’s a source of discovery, connection, and pure enjoyment. There’s a time and place for every type of dish, from hidden neighborhood gems to tried-and-true favorites, and we exist to connect people with the food they love in all the ways they like to dig in. We’ve been at it since 2004, but now, as part of Wonder, Grubhub is operating with a renewed sense of momentum and the high-velocity energy of a powerhouse startup.

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience. We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City and Chicago, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Web Engineer to join our Post Purchase Experience (PPX) team. The PPX team owns critical post-purchase journeys for millions of diners and partners across our Web ecosystems—including core order tracking, delivery tracking for Web DaaS (Delivery as a Service), notification management, and post-checkout features like driver ratings and in-app drop-off photos.

In this role, you will lead web-facing projects end-to-end, partner closely with cross-functional counterparts (Mobile, Backend, Product, Design, Data Science), drive feature delivery via modern feature flagging methodologies, and act as a web steward for the broader Diner Web ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities & Scope**

Technical Ownership & Web Delivery

* Repo Management: Act as a core contributor and owner across our web properties:
  + Diner Web: Main web application handling post-purchase order status, delivery progression, and order support.
  + Delivery Tracking (Web DaaS): Web tracking interfaces powering enterprise and third-party delivery experiences.
  + Notification Templates & PPX BFF Integration: Manage front-end notification views and collaborate on the PPX Backend-For-Frontend (shared with the Braveheart team).
* Project Ownership: Take full ownership of web projects—from dissecting product briefs, conducting spike investigations, and writing technical specs to final rollout and post-launch retrospectives.
* Architecture & API Design: Define clean JSON contracts and API endpoints with Backend counterparts; establish custom metrics, telemetry, and Datadog dashboards in partnership with Product.

**Qualifications**

Must-Haves

* Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with a focus on modern web applications (React, Next.js, TypeScript, or equivalent web frameworks).
* End-to-End Ownership: Proven experience taking complex features from product design (Figma) and API contract definition through build, release, and post-launch telemetry.
* Feature Flagging & Experimentation: Hands-on experience with feature management platforms (e.g., DevCycle, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) for controlled rollouts and A/B testing.
* Monitoring & Operational Excellence: Experience setting up production observability (Datadog, Sentry, or similar), handling on-call rotations, and triaging production incidents (SEVs).
* Communication & Leadership: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; comfort leading discussions across Web, Mobile, BE, Product, Design, and QA.

**Nice-to-Have**s

* Experience with Backend-For-Frontend (BFF) architectures or Node.js services.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms (Spinnaker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and web deployment pipelines.
* Background in e-commerce, food delivery, logistics, or real-time tracking systems.

New York: $176,000- $191,000

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

**A Final Note**

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

**We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Federal
jobs.description:
**About Starbridge**
====================

We're building the front door for how businesses partner with government in America.

Public agencies spend roughly a trillion dollars a year with private companies, and nearly all of it still moves through infrastructure that hasn't changed in decades. Starbridge is building the full operating system for that relationship: the data, the signals, the workflows, and the rails that let a company find a public buyer, win the work, and get paid.

We monitor 320,000+ public sector entities around the clock. 500+ customers have joined us since our launch in March. We've raised $50M from top investors including Craft and Michael Seibel of Y Combinator.

**About the role**
------------------

Starbridge Federal is a small team inside Starbridge focused on companies selling to the federal government. We're hiring a software engineer to build and own SweetSpot, our federal product, and to bring what works there into the core Starbridge platform.

This is a small team with tons of ownership. You'll work directly with the founders and the engineering lead on what to build, then take it from idea to production yourself. There's no layer of PMs or tickets between you and the problem: you'll talk to users, make the technical calls, ship, and keep improving what you shipped.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the frontend and Python on the backend. We're particularly interested in someone who enjoys working with AI tools and building agents and automations into their own workflow.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

* **Own Starbridge Federal end to end.** Build new features across the frontend and backend, maintain and improve what's already there, and keep it fast and reliable in production.
* **Build with AI.** Work on semantic search, search infrastructure, and AI-driven workflows that help companies find and win federal opportunities.
* **Work directly with founders.** Shape the product roadmap with leadership and customers, not just implement a spec.
* **Raise the bar.** Make sound technical decisions, write maintainable code with meaningful tests, and help set engineering practices for a small team.

**What you bring:**
-------------------

* **1–5 years of experience as a software engineer** shipping production code, with a track record of fast growth.
* **Strong Python and React/TypeScript.** You're comfortable across the full stack and can own a feature from database to UI.
* **Solid fundamentals.** Data structures, concurrency, databases, and system design, including how to scale a system and handle failures.
* **Ownership.** You've owned something meaningful end to end and want more of that, not less.
* **Startup experience**, or a clear appetite for a fast-moving, small-team environment.
* **Curiosity about AI and automation.** You use AI tools and agents to move faster and enjoy experimenting with new ones.
* **Based in or willing to relocate to NYC** and work from our office.
* **U.S. citizenship is required**, as this role will have access to our federal environment.

**Bonus if you have:**

* Experience with search, LLMs, or data-heavy products.
* Experience with government data, GovTech, or regulated industries.
* Experience with GCP or AWS.

**Interview process**

We move fast — really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed.

* A 15-minute intro chat with the hiring manager.
* A 30-minute programming exercise.
* A 1-hour pair programming session on a real codebase: fixing bugs and adding a feature.
* An onsite in our NYC office, where you'll build a small feature end to end with the team and meet our founders.

How we work

* **Build Bridges to Help Customers Win -** We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.
* **Shooting Star Speed -** We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.
* **Fun Is a Feature -** We intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.
* **In the Arena -** We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

Benefits include

* Competitive salary + early-stage equity
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Company-provided lunch in the office every day
* Gym stipend
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Unlimited PTO
* Regular offsites (NYC + global locations)

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3, Verso
jobs.description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

New York, NY

**Senior Software Engineer, Publishing Platform (Frontend-focused Full Stack)**

  

**About Condé Nast**  
Condé Nast stands as a distinguished media powerhouse, celebrated for curating top-tier content for the globe's most impactful audiences. Engaging over a billion consumers through its cutting-edge print, digital, and video brands, the portfolio proudly features some of the most iconic titles in the media landscape, including Architectural Digest, Bon Appétit, Condé Nast Traveler, GQ, Pitchfork, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, Vogue, and WIRED.

  

Consistently delivering excellence, Condé Nast extends its influence across 32 markets worldwide, with headquarters in both London and New York, embodying a commitment to quality and innovation.

**About Condé Nast Technology**  
Condé Nast Technology builds the products, systems, and experiences that power our brands. Our mission is to enable creativity and business growth through next-generation publishing, loyalty, and commerce platforms.

We’re a global team of designers, engineers, product managers, and researchers dedicated to creating innovative, user-centric products that enable world-class storytelling and digital experiences.

You’ll be part of a talented international team working across London, New York, and ten other markets, collaborating daily with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, UX, and Data. We partner closely with Consumer Marketing, Commercial, Licensing, Editorial, and Brand teams to ensure our tools and experiences deliver real impact.

Together, we’re shaping how our brands create, publish, and connect with audiences worldwide, combining craft, technology, and collaboration to deliver quality at scale.

**About Our Engineering Team**

Our engineering team builds and evolves Verso, the shared front-end platform powering more than 70 Condé Nast brand sites worldwide. We specialize in modern React architectures, performance-optimized experiences, multi-brand configuration systems, and flexible storytelling tools that enable teams to move fast while maintaining exceptional quality.

We value craft. We value clarity. We value performance. We value governance. We believe that exceptional digital experiences require engineering, product and design working in lockstep.

**About the role**  
Our brands are our USP. The expression of our iconic brands – from Vogue to the New Yorker – within their digital experiences is of utmost importance in our mission to create the best places to consume and interact with our brands.

  

We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve Verso, our shared publishing platform. Your work will focus primarily on React and TypeScript interfaces, with ownership extending into the Node.js runtime, data fetching, and service integrations that power them. You’ll take changes from technical discovery through delivery and production support.

  

You’ll turn editorial and design needs into accessible, performant interfaces used across multiple brands and markets. This includes building shared components, supporting distinctive brand experiences through configuration, and improving the architecture that connects content to the page.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Product Design Lead, editorial partners, and platform engineers to bridge design intent with production-quality code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Areas of Impact:**

* Build and evolve the publishing platform
  + Build polished, high quality UI elements as React components with a strong focus on layout, typography and interactive fidelity.
  + Explain technical decisions and trade-offs to Design, Product, and Editorial partners. Agree on delivery milestones, communicate progress, and raise risks early.
  + Utilize modern React and Typescript features. Familiarity with React 18+, TypeScript, hooks, suspense, SSR concepts, and emerging RSC patterns are expected.
  + Write semantic, maintainable code with clear component and service boundaries. Use peer reviews to explain trade-offs, incorporate feedback, and improve the solution.. Your code should be written with long-term scalability in mind.
  + Work with GraphQL schemas, fragments, and resolvers to deliver efficient, minimal data payloads.
  + Shape GQL patterns that support component-driven design and editorial storytelling flows.
  + Design and deliver features across Verso’s React application, Node.js runtime, and service integrations, with clear ownership from implementation through production support.
  + Evolve the platform’s fetch, transform, and render architecture while keeping responsibilities and service boundaries clear.
  + Design configuration-driven solutions that support different brands and markets without introducing brand-specific application logic.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Voice AI [NYC or SF]
jobs.description:
**About Concurrence**
=====================

Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.

Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support.

Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco.

**About this role**
===================

As a Research Engineer, Voice AI at Concurrence, you'll build and tune speech models for patient conversations and ambient clinical audio. You'll own models from data and training through evaluation and production, working with runtime engineers on streaming inference, latency and turn-taking. The work includes full-duplex speech-to-speech models that listen and speak at the same time, handle interruptions and preserve clinical details.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Train and fine-tune speech and audio models for patient calls and clinical encounters
* Own data preparation, training experiments and evaluation code
* Improve streaming inference, turn-taking and interruption handling, balancing model quality, latency and cost
* Define clinical failure cases with clinicians, product and evaluation engineers, and measure the errors that matter to patients
* Evaluate changes on held-out examples, investigate regressions and carry improvements into production
* Use evidence from real conversations to choose the next experiment and shape our modeling approach

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You've personally trained or fine-tuned speech or audio models on large audio datasets as a substantial part of your work
* You've shipped a model into a real-time product, with concrete results on streaming inference, latency, turn-taking or overlapping speech
* You've taken an ambiguous problem, defined a useful metric and led the work through to a model running in production
* You write the training and evaluation code yourself and can explain the choices behind an experiment
* You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output
* You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar
* You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience building or tuning a full-duplex speech-to-speech model, our strongest preference
* Neural audio codecs or audio language models
* Telephone audio, overlapping speech or multi-speaker audio
* Model adaptation for a particular customer, domain or regulated environment

**Benefits (available to Full-Time Employees)**
===============================================

**Health & Wellness**
---------------------

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Daily catered lunch and dinner
* Mental health support and wellness coaching
* Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth

**Growth & Development**
------------------------

* Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences
* Conference attendance budget for professional development
* Annual team offsite
* Academic collaboration opportunities
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Core Values**
===================

* **Patients Win, We Win**

  If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.
* **High Standards, High Care**

  We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them.
* **Thoughtful Urgency**

  We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.
* **Intensely Measured**

  We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it.

**Who Builds With Us**
======================

* **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
* **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
* **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
* **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
* **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Compensation Range: $220K - $300K

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Voice Evaluation [NYC or SF]
new_jobs.description:
**About Concurrence**
=====================

Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.

Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support.

Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco.

**About this role**
===================

As a Software Engineer, Voice Evaluation at Concurrence, you'll build the system that determines whether a voice agent is ready for patients. You'll own realistic audio tests, scoring and the release gate, with authority to block releases that fail it. The tests need to catch failures that a clean transcript can miss, from mishandled interruptions to missed clinical information or a failure to hand off to a person.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Build simulated callers and call-replay tests that exercise the production voice path with real audio
* Test phone trees, hold queues, interruptions, conflicting clinical information and appropriate escalation
* Build scoring systems and calibrate automated judges against human assessments
* Measure clinical failure rates and uncertainty, and test whether simulation results predict behavior on real calls
* Define release criteria with model, runtime, product and clinical colleagues, own the gate and block changes that fail those criteria
* Turn production failures into regression tests, verify fixes and monitor behavior after release
* Maintain held-out evaluation sets so models are tested on examples they did not train against

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You've personally built and owned evaluation or simulation for production agents at scale. Voice and audio experience is a strong preference
* You've built agent simulations or replay systems, implemented scoring and caught a concrete failure before release
* Your evaluation results determined what shipped, and you led that work
* You can explain what a score captures, what it misses and how you checked it against real behavior
* You write reliable software that runs at volume and follow failures through to a verified fix
* You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output
* You're low ego, direct, and can hold the line on release criteria with evidence
* You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience calibrating automated judges against human labels
* Load testing and concurrent calls using audio
* Speech or audio machine learning
* Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment

**Benefits (available to Full-Time Employees)**
===============================================

**Health & Wellness**
---------------------

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Daily catered lunch and dinner
* Mental health support and wellness coaching
* Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth

**Growth & Development**
------------------------

* Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences
* Conference attendance budget for professional development
* Annual team offsite
* Academic collaboration opportunities
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Core Values**
===================

* **Patients Win, We Win**

  If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.
* **High Standards, High Care**

  We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them.
* **Thoughtful Urgency**

  We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.
* **Intensely Measured**

  We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it.

**Who Builds With Us**
======================

* **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
* **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
* **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
* **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
* **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Compensation Range: $220K - $300K

The Medical Research Data Scientist will work in the Department of Neurology under the direction of the Principal Investigator and in collaboration with faculty investigators, biostatisticians, research staff, trainees, and data analysts. The position will support epidemiologic studies of Parkinson’s disease and related neurological disorders, applying data science and statistical methods to investigate disease risk, progression, treatment effectiveness, and patient outcomes.

The Medical Research Data Scientist will apply advanced data science, statistical, and computational methods to complex research projects. The successful candidate will work with large and diverse data sources, including electronic health records, administrative data, and longitudinal research data. This may include developing and implementing data collection approaches using wearable devices to track environmental exposures, geolocation, and continuous biometric measures, such as electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings. **About X, the Moonshot Factory**

X is a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup.

**About the Team:**

Our team – Bellwether – operates at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and pressing issues with enterprise customers, governments, and more. We focus on severe weather manifestations of climate change, such as wildfires, and aim to use a wide range of data and analytics to better understand and predict what these events could mean for communities and businesses across the globe. We do this through the detection and classification of the features and patterns of the natural and built worlds, the application of cutting-edge machine learning, and the redesign of the full geo-ML workflow. This work extends into development and production-level work as well, as Bellwether also has a number of products that are live with customers. The result: tools and models that allow a range of industries to better leverage earth observation insights.

**About the Role:**  
  
We are looking for a **Lead Data Scientist** to build and unify the data infrastructure that powers our model training pipelines for Project Bellwether. In this role, you will lead the effort to construct a comprehensive multimodal data corpus—integrating geospatial, imagery, sensor, and operational feeds—that serves as a strategic moat for pre- and post-disaster response and resilience.
  
  
Your primary focus will be designing automated ingestion pipelines for complex multimodal datasets, establishing rigorous data quality validation frameworks, and managing dataset versioning to support continuous machine learning training loops. You will bridge the gap between operations, remote annotation teams, and machine learning engineers to ensure our disaster-response models are trained on reliable, high-fidelity, and well-structured data.

* Architect and build automated ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) data pipelines to aggregate, clean, and harmonize data from disparate sources, databases, and operational ingestion flows.
* Implement DataOps practices, including data quality monitoring, automated schema validation, and anomaly detection to catch corrupt or mislabeled data early.

* Lead the end-to-end development of multimodal machine learning models, driving innovation from research and dataset architecture to production deployment for pre- and post-disaster response.
* Define product and data strategy around the multimodal data corpus, leveraging proprietary datasets as a strategic moat for AI-driven disaster resilience tools.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize model performance, scalability, and integration into existing product workflows.
* Establish best practices for MLOps, including model versioning, automated testing, and performance tracking to ensure reliable and high-quality deployments.
* Help hire and grow the data science function, setting the technical bar and culture as the team scales.
* Design, build, and maintain robust data ontologies and taxonomies to systematically organize, categorize, and integrate complex geospatial and multimodal datasets.

**What you should have:**

* Education: Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Data Engineering & Architecture: 7+ years experience building scalable data pipelines, managing relational and non-relational databases, and unifying fragmented data storage systems.
* Modern Python Proficiency: Expertise in Python and data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, or SQL).
* Data Quality & DataOps: Practical experience implementing automated data validation, quality control frameworks, and dataset versioning practices.
* ML Data Lifecycle Understanding: Hands-on experience structuring datasets specifically for machine learning workflows, including handling annotations, metadata tracking, and training set curation.

**It’d be great if you also had these:**

* Pipeline Design & Ingestion: Construct automated ELT/ETL pipelines to aggregate, clean, and integrate complex geospatial, satellite image, and telemetry streams into unified repositories at scale and large volume.
* Quality Governance & DataOps: Deploy comprehensive data validation systems, schema checks, and anomaly monitoring to ensure machine learning components rely on robust, high-fidelity information.
* Versioning & Tracking: Maintain structured dataset versioning infrastructure to enable reproducible model testing and efficient retrieval of operational features.
* Workflow & Label Integration: Harmonize external labeling pipelines and annotation feeds into streamlined, model-ready training assets.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders to convert complex sensor attributes into targeted features for prediction pipelines.
* Geospatial Data: Experience working with geospatial data (good knowledge of data sources and formats), GIS tools, and spatial analytics libraries (e.g., GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio, Shapely, Zarr, COGs…).

**Job Description:**
====================

**What we're building**
=======================

We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start.

Baker Tilly is the sixth-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**About Mytra:**

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

**About the role**
------------------

The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how and in what sequence; in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests. We are constantly solving dynamically changing multi-agent path finding and task allocation problems against a live fleet.

We are looking for someone smart, hungry, and genuinely excited by algorithmic and optimization problems, with solid backend fundamentals. This person will help define the behavior of our robotics fleet to make our system as optimized as possible.

**Problems we solve:**
----------------------

* Multi-agent path finding at fleet scale. Collision-free, time-feasible trajectories, where every bot's path may intersect and constrain every other's.
* Task assignment under precedence constraints. Which bot does what, in what order, when the work has dependencies.
* Storage and retrieval strategy. Where a payload should be stored based on a variety of metadata, and what to move out of the way to reach one that's buried.
* Continuous replanning. Re-prioritizing and adapting to new or canceled work without stalling the fleet.
* State truth and reconciliation. Mapping where everything is in the physical world in our digital twin; automating recovery when the physical and digital worlds differ; recovery from spills, maintenance zones, network drops, and more unpredictable problems!
* Observability. Making a planning cycle legible enough to debug.
* WMS integration. Mapping a customer's model of their work onto our system - and then using that data to optimize their deployment of the Mytra system.

**Ideal Candidates**
--------------------

* Genuinely like algorithmic and optimization problems. Search, scheduling, routing, constraint solving, graph problems; these are the kind of thing you choose to think about, and you have chased some of them down before.
* You've written backend software that other people depended on: a service, an API, something with a database behind it.
* You've worked directly with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres.
* You can own a defined piece of work end to end from general direction rather than daily supervision.
* You find answers on your own: you can identify ambiguity, know which questions to ask, and are proactive about getting answers quickly.
* You learn fast, and you want to!
* You are proficient in Go (or similar backend languages), or can be productive in it quickly.
* You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently.
* 2+ years of production experience.

**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* Helpful, not required: any exposure to multi-agent path finding, task allocation, constraint problems, or other search based algorithms; Warehouse automation or AMR fleet management; working with a relational database at scale; experience with NATS or other message pub/sub tools; participated in an on call rotation for a live system with real customers

**A Final Note:**
-----------------

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last

**Benefits Include:**

* Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high-growth company backed by top-tier VCs

* 401(k) plans and employer-subsidized life insurance

* Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together
* Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
* Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity
* Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit
* Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases
* Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters

**Pay Notice**
--------------

Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change.

***This role requires on-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.***

$145,000 - $175,000 USD

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer-ML Platform
new_jobs.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 47209

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

**Why User Behavior?**
======================

As a Senior Software Engineer on the User Behavior ML Platform, you will build the data and serving foundation behind Roblox's user-level safety understanding, so that every safety system can see who a user is, not just what a single piece of content looks like.

You will own the core ML platform for a new capability at Roblox: a safety user feature store, user embeddings, and risk scores that power personalized consequences, proactive detection, and early education. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale ML systems that shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.

**You will:**
-------------

* Build the Safety User Feature Store: Design and operate the pipelines that turn violations, reports, appeals, filter activity, and engagement signals into reliable, well-documented user features for training and serving.
* Serve User Embeddings and Risk Scores: Take user embeddings and risk models from offline training to production, including low-latency online lookup and similar-user search for detection teams.
* Build the Real-Time Path: Extend batch pipelines to streaming, so fresh behavioral signals reach models and downstream safety systems within minutes, not days.
* Enable ML Teams to Move Fast: Partner with MLEs and Data Scientists to provide self-serve tooling for feature discovery, training data generation, offline evaluation, and A/B experiment hooks.
* Own Data Quality and Governance: Build monitoring for feature freshness, drift, lineage, and ownership, so teams across Safety can trust and reuse signals.
* Design for Trust and Auditability: Build systems that support explainability, fairness review, and appeals correction, since these signals directly shape consequences for millions of users.
* Ship Code, Not Just Designs: Own end-to-end delivery, from system design through migration, testing, production operation, and oncall.

**You have:**
-------------

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production ML platforms, data infrastructure, or large-scale backend systems.
* Strong experience with batch and streaming data pipelines (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka) feeding feature stores or similar ingestion layers.
* Experience designing low-latency serving systems: service APIs (RPC/gRPC), key-value storage, caching, and high-throughput read paths.
* Proficiency in Python and a statically-typed backend language (Go, Java, or similar).
* Solid production operations fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, oncall, and incident response for systems with real user-facing impact.
* Comfort partnering with ML engineers, with a working understanding of the model lifecycle: training data generation, offline evaluation, deployment, and drift monitoring.
* Nice to have:
* + Experience in Trust & Safety, content moderation, user detection, or other adversarial domains
  + Experience with user-level modeling or user understanding
  + Experience with embeddings and vector similarity search in production
  + Familiarity with feature store platforms and signal governance
  + Experience building agentic workflows or tool interfaces for LLM agents (e.g., MCP)

**You are:**
------------

* A Systems Thinker: capable of designing platforms that ML and detection teams build on, not just point solutions.
* A Pragmatic Builder: scrappy and impact-oriented, comfortable turning scattered, undocumented signals into clean, well-owned data products.
* Comfortable with Ambiguity: this space is still being defined, and you will help set the standard rather than follow an existing one.
* A Reliability-Minded Engineer: you treat data quality, testing, migrations, and oncall as first-class parts of the job.
* A Strong Collaborator: you work effectively across ML, Policy, Product, and Detection teams, and make the people around you faster.
* Committed to Ethical, Responsible Engineering: dedicated to building systems that are fair, auditable, and operate with the utmost responsibility toward user safety.

Tesla uniquely builds foundational Super Intelligence that moves beyond pixels and through the physical world. Making that happen at scale means running factories at a speed and consistency traditional manufacturing has never been able to pull off. Factory Software is the digital nervous system holding this operation together - their code manages inventory across automated warehouses, orchestrates every step of assembly across thousands of real-time station controllers, and tracks every bolt & build along the way. Beyond keeping lines moving, they build the foundation that keeps them healthy; the team leverages data pipelines, computer vision, maintenance systems, and SI agents to catch defects early, troubleshoot issues, and stand up new lines faster. Because a single outage can stop production cold, you'll be designing fault-tolerant, low-latency backend systems that scale as our factories evolve. Without Factory Software, Cybercabs and Optimus wouldn't make it out the door with the precision and reliability our world demands.The role is open to any Gigafactory site (Fremont, Austin, Reno, Buffalo).

* Partner directly with cross-functional teams across Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Controls, Supply Chain, Material Flow, and Quality to scope real-world bottlenecks and rapidly iterate on solutions as our Gigafactories evolve
* Uphold high engineering standards and drive platform adoption through mentorship, code reviews, design docs, internal tooling, and evaluating upstream ecosystem advancements to keep our systems simple, reliable, and ahead of production scale

We're looking for an engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, improving system performance, and building automated solutions that enable engineering teams to develop and deploy software efficiently.

You'll own core infrastructure, starting by building on our existing patterns with room to challenge and redesign them for efficiency, and help steer the technical decisions behind New Lantern's growth. The work includes infrastructure as well as backend development in Python, with medium-to-large projects you'll take from design all the way to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Own infrastructure and platform projects end to end, from design and implementation to deployment and monitoring.
* Start by leading the redesign of our DICOM image ingestion pipeline, the system that brings medical images into the platform, for higher volume, availability, and reliability.
* Build and extend cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud using Kubernetes and Terraform, following and improving our existing patterns.
* Write backend code in Python and Django, including domain modeling for core platform services.
* Strengthen CI/CD and automated deployments (lower priority).
* Define and track reliability targets (SLOs and SLIs), and use monitoring and logging tools to find and fix problems quickly.
* Partner with our head of security to harden and clean up infrastructure.
* Collaborate with product managers, customer support, and customers, including radiologists, technologists, and practice administrators, to understand requirements and validate solutions.
* Participate in on-call rotations to maintain platform availability and respond to operational incidents.

**Required Qualifications**

* An end-to-end ownership mindset across design, implementation, testing, and monitoring.
* Hands-on experience building and operating production infrastructure on a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
* Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes, ideally) and automated deployments, including CI/CD pipelines.
* At least a year of real application development in a general-purpose language, ideally Python. Infrastructure scripting alone (Bash, Ansible, and similar) isn't enough; you've written backend code.
* A strong grasp of site reliability practices: defining SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs, and using monitoring and logging tools (such as Datadog, Grafana, or ELK) to troubleshoot production issues.
* Experience redesigning medium-to-large systems and domain models, with strong domain model design skills, and building infrastructure for scalability, availability, and reliability.
* Critical thinking: you gather requirements and question assumptions before you design, and you check that what you build works end to end.
* Curiosity and the drive to learn unfamiliar tools and domains quickly.
* Track record of continuously improving personal and team productivity and velocity by using AI.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Google Cloud, Kubernetes, and Terraform specifically.
* Experience with Django, Celery, Pub/Sub, and Postgres.
* Experience with GitHub Actions.
* Experience building and operating production data processing or ingestion pipelines.
* Experience with multi-tenant platforms serving many customers and sites.
* Breadth across tools, with the judgment to weigh trade-offs between several approaches.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Real scope, early.** Lead multi-million dollar client deployments end-to-end.
* **Direct access.** No layers between you and engineering, leadership, or clients.

new_jobs.title: Research Engineer, Voice AI [NYC or SF]
new_jobs.description:
**About Concurrence**
=====================

Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.

Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support.

Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco.

**About this role**
===================

As a Research Engineer, Voice AI at Concurrence, you'll build and tune speech models for patient conversations and ambient clinical audio. You'll own models from data and training through evaluation and production, working with runtime engineers on streaming inference, latency and turn-taking. The work includes full-duplex speech-to-speech models that listen and speak at the same time, handle interruptions and preserve clinical details.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Train and fine-tune speech and audio models for patient calls and clinical encounters
* Own data preparation, training experiments and evaluation code
* Improve streaming inference, turn-taking and interruption handling, balancing model quality, latency and cost
* Define clinical failure cases with clinicians, product and evaluation engineers, and measure the errors that matter to patients
* Evaluate changes on held-out examples, investigate regressions and carry improvements into production
* Use evidence from real conversations to choose the next experiment and shape our modeling approach

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* You've personally trained or fine-tuned speech or audio models on large audio datasets as a substantial part of your work
* You've shipped a model into a real-time product, with concrete results on streaming inference, latency, turn-taking or overlapping speech
* You've taken an ambiguous problem, defined a useful metric and led the work through to a model running in production
* You write the training and evaluation code yourself and can explain the choices behind an experiment
* You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output
* You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar
* You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience building or tuning a full-duplex speech-to-speech model, our strongest preference
* Neural audio codecs or audio language models
* Telephone audio, overlapping speech or multi-speaker audio
* Model adaptation for a particular customer, domain or regulated environment

**Benefits (available to Full-Time Employees)**
===============================================

**Health & Wellness**
---------------------

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Daily catered lunch and dinner
* Mental health support and wellness coaching
* Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth

**Growth & Development**
------------------------

* Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences
* Conference attendance budget for professional development
* Annual team offsite
* Academic collaboration opportunities
* Unlimited PTO

**Our Core Values**
===================

* **Patients Win, We Win**

  If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.
* **High Standards, High Care**

  We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them.
* **Thoughtful Urgency**

  We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.
* **Intensely Measured**

  We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it.

**Who Builds With Us**
======================

* **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
* **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
* **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
* **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
* **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Compensation Range: $220K - $300K

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer - AI Education Systems
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for a skilled and forward-thinking Platform Engineer to join NVIDIA Academy and build the cloud-native platforms that power our global education ecosystem. In this role, you will architect scalable partner-facing tools and internal automation systems that allow NVIDIA to deliver technical education at scale through a growing network of Authorized Learning Partners (ALPs) worldwide. Day to day you will build and run the Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure behind our GPU-accelerated lab environments - reducing manual effort, enabling self-service, and keeping the platform reliable and secure as demand grows.

NVIDIA is an industry leader with groundbreaking developments in HPC, Artificial Intelligence, and accelerated computing. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens new universes to explore, enables outstanding creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions - from artificial intelligence to autonomous vehicles. We invite you to join a small, high-impact team and partner closely with our technical leads to build platforms that bring NVIDIA education to the world - combining deep Kubernetes and AWS expertise with pragmatic automation to create systems that scale our reach, empower our partners, and continuously raise the bar on technical training quality.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Agentic Education Systems: Develop AI-powered agentic workflows that bring intelligence to the education lifecycle - from adaptive learning path recommendations to intelligent scheduling, proactive recertification alerts, and AI-assisted quality assessment of instructors and learners.

* Lab Environment & Training Infrastructure: Design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure that delivers GPU-accelerated lab environments for ILT and self-paced courses at scale.

* Partner Platform Development: B uild a platform that enables partners to self-manage onboarding, certification tracking, course access, and performance reporting - reducing operational overhead while scaling partner reach globally.

* Container Orchestration: Build and manage Kubernetes-based environments for deploying and scaling platform services and agentic workflows. Define standards for cluster configuration, resource management, and workload isolation.

* Systems Integration: Integrate the education platform with third-party systems via REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth - including LMS platforms, calendar services, badge and credentialing systems, and partner communication tools.

* Automation & CI/CD: Implement infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, repeatable deployments. Automate operational workflows to reduce manual effort across program management, operations, and partner support.

* Reliability & Observability: Own platform uptime, performance, and security in production. Define and monitor SLAs, implement alerting and observability tooling, and drive rapid incident resolution.

Documentation & Collaboration: Produce clear architecture documentation, runbooks, and API references. Working closely with program managers, operations, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.  



**What we need to see:**

* Education: A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or an equivalent experience.
* Cloud Expertise: 8+ years of hands-on experience building and operating production infrastructure on AWS. Strong proficiency with core AWS services: EC2, EKS, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, and CloudWatch.

* Kubernetes Proficiency: Demonstrated experience designing and managing Kubernetes clusters in production. Familiarity with Helm, Kustomize, and cloud-native networking and storage patterns.

* Security: Solid grounding in cloud and platform security: IAM and least-privilege design, secrets management, network segmentation, and container image and supply-chain security. Experience hardening and operating multi-tenant or partner-facing infrastructure.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Able to document technical systems clearly and engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.  



**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience with NVIDIA GPU infrastructure in cloud or on-premises environments (CUDA, GPU operators, NVIDIA AI Enterprise).

* Experience using agentic workflows in an engineering context: AI agents and LLM-powered automation applied to real platform and infrastructure work. A genuine differentiator, not a requirement; deep platform engineering fundamentals matter more.

* Familiarity with LMS platforms, digital credentialing systems, or education-technology ecosystems.

* Hands-on experience with virtual lab platforms or e-learning infrastructure.

157,500 USD – 305,500 USD for Level 4; and 202,500 USD – 383,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

new_jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

**About the Role:**

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

This is a Sr. Software Development Engineer (SDE) role in the CTIO team that delivers the cutting edge innovation for our sensor (lightweight agent) for Linux, Windows, and Mac OS platforms. The Sr. SDE’s in the team own design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Linux, Windows, and MacOS. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.

The CTIO team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
* Conceptualize and develop new product features.
* Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
* Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
* Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Deep knowledge of C/C++.
* Extensive understanding of Linux, Windows, OR Mac OS internals.
* Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks.
* Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases.
* Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

**Bonus Points:**

* Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light-weight, and highly performing systems
* In-depth OS system expertise regarding core concepts and subsystems
* Familiarity and experience utilizing Agile methodologies
* Knowledge of security principles
* Experience with eBPF

This position combines a software development foundation with cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform engineering to help engineering teams build, test, and deploy software faster and more reliably. **People**

* Champion a DevOps culture focused on an automation-first mindset, continuous improvement, collaboration, and transparency.
* Partner with development teams to improve reliability, performance, and deployment practices.

**Client**

**Internal Developer Portal (IDP)**

* Architect and implement an Internal Developer Portal to provide self-service infrastructure, application templates, and deployment workflows.
* Enable “golden paths” for engineering teams to accelerate onboarding and reduce cognitive load.
* Integrate the IDP with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) systems, cloud infrastructure, identity management, and observability platforms.
* Maintain service catalogs, documentation standards, and ownership metadata.
* Continuously improve developer experience through feedback and platform enhancements.

**Value**

**Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) Platform Engineering**

* Design, implement, and maintain fully automated CI/CD pipelines for Java, .NET, and Node.js applications.
* Build standardized deployment workflows across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and/or Microsoft Azure environments.
* Implement automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates within pipelines.
* Establish reusable pipeline templates and shared libraries to enforce best practices.
* Optimize build and deployment performance, reliability, and observability.

**Cloud and Infrastructure Automation**

* Design and manage cloud infrastructure in AWS and/or Azure using infrastructure as code, with Terraform required.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and enforce governance through policy-as-code.
* Implement secure, scalable networking and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and disaster recovery readiness.

**DevOps and Platform Best Practices**

* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting strategies for both infrastructure and applications.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning and secrets management.
* Lead proof-of-concept initiatives to evaluate and introduce new tools, platforms, and automation processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, or platform engineering.
* Demonstrated evolution from software development into cloud infrastructure and automation.
* Six or more years of hands-on experience with CI/CD tools, such as Harness, CloudBees, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps, and modern software delivery practices.
* Deep development expertise in Java and/or Node.js application environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure, including networking, serverless, and other managed cloud infrastructure.
* Advanced proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure as code principles.
* Experience designing scalable cloud-native architectures.
* Strong knowledge of Windows Server and Microsoft SQL Server, including SQL Server Availability Groups.
* Strong scripting skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, and AWS CloudFormation.
* Strong understanding of secure software delivery, Git branching strategies, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience leading technical evaluations and proof-of-concept initiatives for new tools and processes.
* Excellent collaboration skills with the ability to work cross-functionally across engineering, security, and operations teams.
* Clear, transparent communication style with a bias toward documentation and shared ownership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or implementing a commercial Internal Developer Portal, such as Harness IDP, Port, or a similar platform.
* Experience implementing platform engineering concepts and developer self-service models.
* Familiarity with service mesh, application programming interface (API) gateways, or cloud-native networking.
* Experience implementing security automation and compliance guardrails.
* Knowledge of observability platforms, including Datadog, Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Logstash, and Kibana (ELK), and cloud-native tools.
* Experience in multicloud or hybrid cloud environments.

* Bachelor’s degree or higher

AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. When a model with billions of parameters trains across a large scale of GPUs, every minute of downtime costs real progress. You will tackle problems no one has fully defined yet — spanning hardware, firmware, kernel, and software simultaneously. When your system catches a failing GPU before a training job crashes, that is your impact.

Your automation runs at a large scale across servers in the cloud. When you ship, you see failure rates move within days. The team is small enough that your decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you will always have experts to learn from across hardware, firmware, and software.  
  
The Ideal Candidate
